findings.detail: No concrete factual contradiction found between the policy text and the stated facts. The policy does not claim that /datenschutz requires login, and it does not describe the policy page as gated. Login is described only as a feature of the Job Matcher account (Section 8).

Section 19 states that the current version is available on the policy page with version and date. This is consistent with a public Markdown-rendered page and with the version line 'Version 1.1 · Stand: 7. November 2026'.

Open items are explicitly marked as pending or conditional, for example the optional application storage (Section 9), alert deletion periods and unsubscribe mechanics (Section 12), and the final recipient list and transfer safeguards (Section 15). These are acceptable under the review rule.

checks: /datenschutz is a public route and the policy text does not require login to read it
Privacy.tsx fetches and displays the Markdown; the document is consistent with a Markdown-rendered policy page
Storage consent UI links to the policy and shows the text version; Section 9 and Section 10 reference the consent text version as authoritative, which is consistent
No login is required to read the policy; Section 8 describes login only as an account feature
Pending legal approvals (Sections 3, 9, 12, 15, 16) are explicitly marked and therefore acceptable
No statement contradicts the known facts about the policy route, the Markdown rendering, or the consent UI links
